A new **Traffic Map**, live data flow on the Network Map, smoother menus and a round of fixes.

### Traffic Map (Lobby → Traffic Map)

- World map of where your traffic goes right now: countries shaded by traffic and animated arcs from your firewall — dots flow in for downloads and out for uploads, at a speed that follows the traffic
- **Top 20 countries** with live download/upload, share, connections, data transferred and the networks behind them (GOOGLE, AMAZON-02, …); click a row for its top five networks
- Reads the firewall's own state table; LAN and NAT copies of a connection are merged, so nothing is counted twice
- IP data is stored on the firewall and looked up locally: [DB-IP IP to Country Lite](https://db-ip.com) (where an address is located, CC BY 4.0) and [iptoasn.com](https://iptoasn.com) (networks, public domain)
- Downloaded once by the installer, then refreshed by a cron job **daily at 01:00** (System → Settings → Cron); *Update now* on the page
- Separate privilege: **Lobby: Traffic Map**

### Network Map

- **Live data flow**: dots stream along every link — Internet → firewall → each network — with download and upload lanes whose speed follows the traffic
- Busy devices get a ripple around their status dot
- The loopback interface is no longer shown as a network

### Smoother

- Menu sections open in one frame and their items fade in, instead of two panels resizing at once and the menu sliding under the pointer
- Collapsed-rail fly-outs appear solid immediately
- Traffic Map animation runs on a canvas only while the map is on screen, the tab is visible and there is traffic; the map and the arcs are separate layers

### Fixed

- **Sign-in page icons** (user / lock) did not show: the sign-in page and classic PHP pages forbid `data:` images in their Content-Security-Policy. Icons are now inline SVG, and dropdown carets are a file; the build fails on any `data:` URL
- Dashboard gauges: the two lines in the middle overlapped
- Menu sub-levels are laid out as a tidy tree: icon + label, chevrons that rotate, a guide line per open section

### Update

```sh
fetch -o - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ox1d3x3/unisense/main/install.sh | sh
```

The installer restarts configd (for the Traffic Map's backend), schedules the daily database update and starts the first download in the background.
